options.label: background color
options.help: Color treated as background: no paths are drawn in it.

options.label: centerline
options.help: Trace each region's centerline instead of its outline.

options.label: preserve width
options.help: Keep the line width when tracing centerlines.

options.label: remove adjacent corners
options.help: Drop corners that are next to each other.

options.label: color count
options.help: Reduce a color image to this many colors before tracing.

options.label: corner always threshold
options.help: Angles sharper than this are always corners, even close to another corner.

options.label: corner surround
options.help: Pixels on each side of a point used to decide if it's a corner.

options.label: corner threshold
options.help: Where pixels meet at an angle smaller than this, it's a corner.

options.label: despeckle level
options.help: How large the speckles removed before tracing can be.

options.label: error threshold
options.help: Split a fitted curve when it's off by more pixels than this.

options.label: filter iterations
options.help: How many times the outline is smoothed before fitting curves.

options.label: line reversion threshold
options.help: Keep nearly straight curves as straight lines, weighted by curve length.

options.label: line threshold
options.help: Use a straight line when a curve stays within this many pixels of it.

options.label: tangent surround
options.help: Points on each side of a point used to compute its tangent.
